description: WhatsApp video 'digital arrest' lasting 45 minutes; victim finally pays. VoIP + long call stack.

events.text: This is CBI headquarters. Your Aadhaar is linked to a money laundering case. You are under digital arrest.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Do not disconnect this video call. Do not tell your family. You must cooperate immediately.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: To prove your innocence, transfer the amount to the RBI safe account. Keep the video on.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Send it now, rupees 200000, upi id rbi dot safe at ybl
events.speaker: caller
